text:
maria.g: Heads up — planning a late-night simulated egress blackout test + staggered GPU node drains across us-west1 and eu-west1. Goal: validate routing fallback, cache warmup, and verify SLA handoffs. Target window: Tue 02:00–04:00 UTC.

ajenkins: are we doing canary pool first? what backfill ratio?

maria.g: yes canary in us-west1 (2 racks), then 30% cohort drain in remaining pools. Backfill = standby pool + burst from Dedicated reserve.

sahil: define impact envelope — any risk to Dedicated customers' throughput? need to flag sales for tight SLAs.

maria.g: minimal risk if autoscaler behaves. plan includes immediate fallback to model-variant small-q8 for latency-sensitive routes. notify sales + support. i'll ping channel with prepared blurb.

leah: will prefix KV cache warmup be preserved across rollouts? worried about cold-token latency spikes.

maria.g: we'll run a synthetic KV seed job after each cohort drain: `kubectl exec -it preload-job -- ./seed_kv.sh --model gptx-struct --prefixes common_prompts.txt`

ajenkins: incl runbook steps? paste quick commands we use to cordon/drain and rollback.

maria.g: sure — runbook snippet:
```
# cordon
kubectl cordon <node>
# drain gracefully
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
# uncordon on rollback
kubectl uncordon <node>
```

oncall-mike: ops-bot scheduled the window, i've assigned myself for first hour. if any throughput drop > 10% we'll abort and rollback.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: ID MNT-7234. Notifications queued to `@support`, `@sales`, and account owners for Dedicated customers with SLA < 5ms.

sahil: cost check — expected transient egress spike from cross-region fallback. rough estimate?

leah: estimate ~ +12% bandwidth and +8% token compute for 2 hours if fallback hits 20% traffic.

maria.g: noted. finance: we can cover via buffer for this quarter. ops: stick to cohort timeboxes and pre-seed caches aggressively.

ajenkins: final question — any networking changes (BGP) required for fallback routes?

maria.g: no BGP changes. we enable smart-routing rule `egress-fallback: true` in the control plane before starting. will toggle with canary and monitor traceroutes.

sahil: ok. i'll prepare the perf dashboards and alert thresholds (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, egress_mb). send link when ready.

maria.g: thanks. i'll post the customer comm and runbook doc link here 1 hour before window. :thumbsup:
